about: v84h top-down skill-tree panel as compact icon tiles (D2-style). Three trees sit side by side; each packs its 9-node path (v84n: 1,5,...,40) into a 3-wide snake (pack snake3: 1 5 10 / 25 20 15 / 30 35 40) so the whole tree through the 40-point ultimate stays on screen in phone landscape. js/ab-skilltree.js reads this. Node costs stay in data/skilltrees-*.json. Icons come from the skill-button pixel art (Tn / skill id) when present.

header.about: v84n: each tree's header is its +1 button. Tap = +1 point in that tree (and opens it); hold = keep adding (holdDelayMs, then one every holdEveryMs). When the tree can't take a point the header only opens the tree and the chip dims (or reads maxText at 50). minH is the header height in CSS px (>=44 for touch).
